plugins.description: Research county property assessments and prepare draft comparisons from available records. Create a private veteran review PDF from a saved review you select, with unanswered questions shown. County records, your answers and any VA information you choose to share are identified separately. Missing building, identity, tax-year, taxable-value or filing evidence can limit the review. Drafts do not complete official forms, establish eligibility or authorize filing. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).
